mapper.select: SELECT p.pz_num configNum,t.byte_sum totalNum,t.reject_sum blockNum,t.monitor_sum monitorNum,t.drop_conn_sum discardedNum,t.loop_conn_sum refluxNum FROM ( SELECT count(0) pz_num FROM ui_cfg_num_statistics WHERE cfg_state = 1 ) p, ( SELECT sum(c2s_byte_len + s2c_byte_len) byte_sum, sum(reject_num) reject_sum,sum(monitor_num) monitor_sum, sum(drop_conn_num) drop_conn_sum, sum(loop_conn_num) loop_conn_sum FROM NTC_TOTAL_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} ) t

select #{push} time,r.request_title letter,count(s.compile_id) num from ui_request_info r RIGHT join (SELECT t.request_id,t.service_id,t.compile_id,max(t.statistic_time) time FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id) s on r.id = s.request_id WHERE r.is_valid = 1 group by r.request_title

SELECT #{start} time,task.audit_time taskTime,task.task_name taskName, count(lwhh.id) letterNum,COALESCE(sum(num.cfg_num),0) configNum,COALESCE( sum(num.reject_sum),0) monitorNum,COALESCE( sum(num.monit_sum),0) controlNum FROM (select * from ui_task_info where is_valid=1) task left join (select * from ui_request_info where is_valid=1) lwhh on task.id = lwhh.task_id left join ( SELECT req.request_id, count(req.compile_id) cfg_num, sum(pz.reject_sum) reject_sum, sum(pz.monit_sum) monit_sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) req LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.cfg_id, SUM(s.reject_sum) reject_sum, SUM(s.monit_sum) monit_sum FROM ( SELECT p.cfg_id,( CASE WHEN (p.service BETWEEN 16 AND 65) OR (p.service BETWEEN 256 AND 266) OR (p.service BETWEEN 512 AND 576) THEN p.sum ELSE 0 END ) reject_sum, ( CASE WHEN ( (p.service BETWEEN 128 AND 149) OR (p.service BETWEEN 384 AND 394) OR (p.service = 592) ) THEN p.sum ELSE 0 END ) monit_sum FROM ( SELECT t.cfg_id, t.service, t.sum, t.report_time FROM ntc_pz_report t) p ) s GROUP BY s.cfg_id ) pz on pz.cfg_id = req.compile_id GROUP BY req.request_id ) num on lwhh.id = num.request_id group by task_name HAVING (letterNum + configNum + monitorNum+controlNum > 0);

select #{end} time,t.website name,COALESCE(SUM(s.link_sum),0) num from (select t.id,w.website from ui_website_domain_topic t left join (select item_code webid,item_value website from ui_sys_data_dictionary_item where type=1 and dictionary_id=111) w on w.webid = t.website_service_id ) t right JOIN (select web_id,sum(link_num) link_sum from TRAFFIC_HTTP_STATISTIC where web_id>0 group by web_id ) s on s.web_id = t.id group by t.website HAVING name is not null order by num desc limit 10;
SELECT pid audioId,sum(num),max(LOG_URI) url FROM MM_AUDIO_REPORT where report_time >= #{start} and report_time < #{end} group by pid order by num desc limit 10
SELECT pid vedioId,sum(num),max(LOG_URI) url FROM MM_VIDEO_REPORT where report_time >= #{start} and report_time < #{end} group by pid order by num desc limit 10
SELECT pid imageId,sum(num),max(LOG_URI) url FROM MM_PIC_REPORT where report_time >= #{start} and report_time < #{end} group by pid order by num desc limit 10
SELECT account phonenum,sum(num),max(LOG_URI) url FROM MM_VOIP_REPORT where report_time >= #{start} and report_time < #{end} group by account order by num desc limit 10

SELECT task.audit_time time, task.task_name event, sum(case t.service_id when 128 then t.sum else 0 end) as ipNum , sum(case t.service_id when 129 then t.sum else 0 end) as httpNum , sum(case t.service_id when 132 then t.sum else 0 end) as mailNum , sum(case t.service_id when 389 then t.sum else 0 end) as vedioNum , sum(case t.service_id when 592 then t.sum else 0 end) as agentNum FROM (select * from ui_task_info where is_valid=1) task LEFT JOIN (select * from ui_request_info where is_valid=1) lwhh ON task.id = lwhh.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.request_id,r.service_id,COALESCE(SUM(t.sum),0) sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) r , ( SELECT cfg_id, service, sum(sum) sum FROM ntc_pz_report WHERE service IN (128, 129, 132, 389, 592) GROUP BY service, cfg_id )t where t.cfg_id = r.compile_id group by r.request_id,r.service_id) t on t.request_id=lwhh.id group by task.task_name having (ipNum+httpNum+mailNum+vedioNum+agentNum)>0;

SELECT task.audit_time time, task.task_name event, sum(case t.service_id when 16 then t.sum else 0 end) as ipNum , sum(case t.service_id when 17 then t.sum else 0 end) as httpNum , sum(case t.service_id when 20 then t.sum else 0 end) as mailNum , sum(case t.service_id when 261 then t.sum else 0 end) as vedioNum , sum(case t.service_id when 576 then t.sum else 0 end) as agentNum FROM (select * from ui_task_info where is_valid=1) task LEFT JOIN (select * from ui_request_info where is_valid=1) lwhh ON task.id = lwhh.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.request_id,r.service_id,COALESCE(SUM(t.sum),0) sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) r , ( SELECT cfg_id, service, sum(sum) sum FROM ntc_pz_report WHERE service IN (16, 17, 20, 261, 576) GROUP BY service, cfg_id ) t where t.cfg_id = r.compile_id group by r.request_id,r.service_id) t on t.request_id=lwhh.id group by task.task_name having (ipNum+httpNum+mailNum+vedioNum+agentNum)>0;
